## Required Bindings

### Description
We're using InversifyJS for our Injection and IoC requirements. See their [Documentation](https://github.com/inversify/InversifyJS) for more detailed low level information.

You are required to pass an `Inversify.ContainerModule` into the `engine.initialise()` function. The following Injects are required to be bound within it for the engine to run.

#### Required Bindings:
- [GameModel<implement IBaseGameModel>](./wiki/injectable-components/game-model.md)
- [GameSettings<implement IBaseGameSettingsModel>](./wiki/injectable-components/game-settings.md)
- [DebugModel<implement IBaseDebugModel>](./wiki/injectable-components/debug-model.md)
- [GameApplication<implement IGameApp>](./wiki/injectable-components/game-application.md)
- [CoreDataList<implement IAssetConfig>](./wiki/injectable-components/core-data-list.md)
- [Cabinet<extend CabinetPackage>](./wiki/injectable-components/cabinet.md)
- [Skin<implement ISkinDesc>](./wiki/injectable-components/skin-description.md)
- [Strings<extends IStrings>](./wiki/strings.md) // (Optional: Package will attempt to load them from cdn is not bound)

There are 2 main methods of injection in use, Constant bindings and Factory bindings.
#### Constant bindings
These instantiate the item they are binding at the time of calling engine.initialise().

Instantiates:
- after the internal bindings
- before connecting to the parent
- before mounting any Vues

#### Factory bindings
These are functions which will instantiate and bind their Constant counterpart when called. They are called internally by the engine during the bootstrap process and are identifiable by the word Factory in their name.

Instantiates:
- after the constant bindings
- after connecting to the parent
- before mounting any Vues

#### Simple examples
e.g. a Constant item
```ts
    bind<GameModel>(Injects.GameModel).toConstantValue(new GameModel());
```
or a Factory item
```ts
    bind<() => void>(Injects.ComponentFactory).toFactory(() => {
        return () => {
            bind<Cabinet>(Injects.Cabinet).toConstantValue(new Cabinet());
            bind<BigWin>(Injects.BigWin).toConstantValue(new BigWin());
        };
    });
```

#### Optional Bindings
For additional components that you can overwrite see the [Optional Bindings Section](./optional-bindings.md).

### BareBones Example
```ts
// file bindings.ts

import { ContainerModule } from 'inversify';
import { container, Injects, IAssetConfig, IGameApp, ISkinDesc } from '@arcade-client/base-package';

export const containerModule = new ContainerModule((bind, __, ___, rebind) => {
    bind<IAssetConfig>(Injects.CoreDataList).toConstantValue(coreDataList);
    bind<GameModel>(Injects.GameModel).toConstantValue(new GameModel);
    bind<GameSettings>(Injects.GameSettings).toConstantValue(new GameSettings);
    bind<DebugModel>(Injects.DebugModel).toConstantValue(new DebugModel);
    bind<IGameApp>(Injects.GameApp).toConstantValue(new GameApplication());

    bind<() => void>(Injects.SkinFactory).toFactory(() => {
        return async () => {
            const skinName = container.frameConnection.parentConstants.currentSkin;
            const { skinDescription } = await import(`@/src/skins/${skinName}`);
            bind<ISkinDesc>(Injects.Skin).toConstantValue(skinDescription);
        };
    });

    bind<() => void>(Injects.ComponentsFactory).toFactory(() => {
        return () => {
            bind<Cabinet>(Injects.Cabinet).toConstantValue(new Cabinet());
            bind<BigWin>(Injects.BigWin).toConstantValue(new BigWin()); // optional
        };
    });
});
```
